title: Tech reads digest with engineering blogs and quality filters
summary: The digest now pulls from engineering blogs alongside Reddit and HN, with improved ranking and parallel batch summarization. Replies to email job posts now load linked emails for context.

sections.heading: New
items: Tech reads digest powered by Reddit, Hacker News, and engineering blogs (Claude, Cloudflare, Netflix, GitHub, Slack, Meta and others)
Digest now interactively ranks posts with per-source quotas so blogs cannot crowd out Reddit

sections.heading: Improved
items: Refocused digest on code review, infra and reliability; dropped databases, self-promotion and self-hosting
Batch summarization in groups of four to prevent the model from stopping early
Replaced category/source fields with favicon and category icons for cleaner layout

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Replies to email job posts now automatically read linked emails to provide context
Stopped falsely reporting successful calendar events when the API call actually failed

links.label: Digest rework with blogs and filters
